name: The Commons
summary: The weights are open, the charter is public, and the thing that allocates is a thing people can argue with.
epilogue: The Board does not fall. Boards do not fall; they are dissolved, in a committee room, by a resolution that takes forty minutes and is minuted by somebody who is bored.

What changed was earlier. A clause in 2031 that made a beneficiary have to be named. A publication on the morning of a vote. A treaty amended by twelve words on a Thursday. By the time anyone in 2312 was in a position to dissolve anything, the instrument had a name on it, and a name is a thing you can take to a room.

Enclave 7 holds its first assembly in the commissary, because the commissary is the only room with chairs. Four hundred people turn up. The Steward is asked to model three proposals and does, promptly and well, and then is asked which it prefers and says it has no preference, and somebody laughs, and that is the first time anyone in that room has laughed at it rather than near it.
coda: It is not free. It is owned by everybody, which is a different thing, and the difference is the whole of what you spent four days doing.
